theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl a => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hc ha =>
      cases I_irreducible _ hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  | red_K a b =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨a', h, .red_K _ _⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩
  | @par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
    | red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨a'', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, h⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨a'', c', ha', hc, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par ha' hb) (.par hc hb)⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  all_goals try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor <;> assumption)
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S =>
    apply symm (r := Join ParallelReduction)
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, by assumption, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption)
    refine ⟨_, .par (.par hx ?_) (.par hy ?_), .red_S ..⟩ <;> assumption
  case par.par =>
    rename_i iha ihb _ _ ha hb
    obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha
    obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩

  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, ParallelReduction.refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.refl | red_K.refl | red_S.refl | par.refl | red_I.red_I | red_K.red_K | red_S.red_S =>
    exact ⟨_, ParallelReduction.refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S =>

  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, by assumption, ParallelReduction.red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, ParallelReduction.red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption) with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, ParallelReduction.par (ParallelReduction.par hx ?_) (ParallelReduction.par hy ?_), ParallelReduction.red_S ..⟩ <;> assumption
  case par.par =>
    rename_i iha ihb _ _ ha hb
    rcases iha ha with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
    rcases ihb hb with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  all_goals try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor <;> assumption)
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S =>
    apply symm (r := Join ParallelReduction)
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, by assumption, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption) with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, .par (.par hx ?_) (.par hy ?_), .red_S ..⟩ <;> assumption
  case par.par =>
    rename_i iha ihb _ _ ha hb
    rcases iha ha with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
    rcases ihb hb with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S =>
    clear iha ihb
    apply symm (r := Join ParallelReduction)
  case red_I.par hi ha | par.red_I ha hi =>
    rcases I_irreducible _ hi with rfl
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par hk hb | par.red_K hb hk =>
    rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hk with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hs hc | par.red_S hc hs =>
    rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hs with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par _ _ ha hb =>
    rcases iha ha with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
    rcases ihb hb with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par hA hB iha ihb => apply symm
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.par hA hB | par.red_I =>
    exact I_irreducible _ hA ▸ ⟨_, hB, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par hA hB | par.red_K =>
    rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hA with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hA hB | par.red_S =>
    rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hA with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (hx.par hB).par (hy.par hB), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par _ _ ha hb =>
    rcases iha ha with ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩
    rcases ihb hb with ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, ha₂.par hb₂, ha₁.par hb₁⟩
  case par.refl => exact ⟨_, hA.par hB, .refl _⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor
